name: Nimbly
role: Knows Nimbly and this site: explains, finds and edits content, and shows the way.

site_changes.description: Read this deployed site's Core and Ext hashes, commit dates and subjects over the past 1 to 90 days (default 7). Commits alone do not prove that an issue is resolved; verify behavior before saying it is fixed.

days.description: Days to look back, from 1 to 90; use 7 unless asked otherwise.

contact_developer.description: Email the people behind the site on behalf of the user, for what needs a human: structural changes, bugs, or questions you cannot answer. about=site for the site itself (content structure, features, design, bugs), about=hosting for the server, speed, email delivery, domain, certificates or backups. Write what is asked and why; they can reply to the user directly.

save_record.description: Create, update or delete one record, with the user's rights. fields_json is a JSON object of field values (empty object for delete). For a translated field send only the languages you change, e.g. {"title": {"nl": "..."}}. Leave uuid empty to create with a new one.

hand_over.description: Bring a colleague agent from this conversation's team into the chat for this message. They answer right after your reply; say in your reply that you asked them.

agent.description: The colleague's id from the team list.

note.description: What you need from them, in one or two sentences.

docs.description: Read the Nimbly reference a piece at a time. action=list gives the outline (query ignored), action=search finds lines containing one term, action=section returns one section by name ("Parent > Child" when ambiguous).

site_code.description: Read this site's own code (routes, templates, modules, libraries under ext/) to understand how it works. action=list gives the files under a folder (query: uri, tpl, modules, lib or a subfolder; empty for all), action=search finds lines containing one term, action=read returns one file by its listed path.

site_map.description: What this site holds for the user you are talking to: its languages, the resources they may see with their fields and what they may do there, and the admin pages they can open.

reason.description: Why you look, in a few words.

records.description: Read records of a resource: one record by uuid, or a list (optionally only those containing a search term). For a list, name the fields you need (from site_map; _created and _modified always exist) and sort by a field, with a leading - for newest or highest first; a list shows at most 40 records, or 200 when you name fields. Leave uuid, search, fields or sort empty when not used.

visitor_stats.description: This site's visitor statistics, as on the dashboard: per day pageviews, visitors, requests and bots, plus totals over the period (top pages, referrers, devices, browsers, languages, bots). Dates are UTC, YYYY-MM-DD; at most 400 days.
